title: Record an odontogram
summary: From the record: Create → Odontogram session, to mark the status of each tooth.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient: clinical, financial and scheduling.

steps.title: Odontogram session
steps.details: Opens the odontogram for a new session.

steps.title: Odontogram
steps.details: Choose a condition and tap the tooth or surface. When saved it stays as a session on the timeline.
